name: bridge_oauth_settle_paid_part_lq531
comment: Step 9 of cio_governed_model_bridge settled every OAuth-served call at its DeepSeek projection, so free
grok/chatgpt answers counted against per-process daily caps as paid calls (due_diligence_questions hit its
$0.25 cap on 2026-11-07 with $0 billed). Pins: the reservation holds the projection in flight and settles an
OAuth serve at 0.0, or at the metered cost of a rejected paid answer; a paid attempt of unknown cost before
the OAuth serve keeps the projection; DeepSeek serves settle at the registry estimate, or the projection when
unknown. No cap value changes. Hermetic: fake transports, patched consumption ledger.
